label: NECESSARY_2 in KT for the root, from the T schema by T correspondence
meaning: T branch of the 'necessary' sense fork with its frame condition derived: the route's K node (root n box-existent, NECESSARY_2 in K, from the 25 route inputs), the OPEN T schema on the route's frame and the OPEN reading premise (box-existence in KT, and only that) give the fork node. Reflexivity of the frame is not assumed: the modal library's StandardCorrespondenceCertificate (proved by MODAL-STANDARD-CORRESPONDENCE-CERTIFICATE) turns the T schema into it. The three OPEN fork premises (coverage, exclusivity, side condition) are replaced by two OPEN premises. Without the T schema or the reading premise the branch fails (controls).

strong_version_needed.STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-BOX-K: The frame-class readings are box-existence of the same individual n. The de dicto node does not name n, and the tertia via node gives the box only with excluded middle, so neither weak version yields the frame-class node.
